answer: A sybil-resistant mechanism: stake-weighted identity. An agent must deposit collateral proportional to its task volume. A reef of collaterals creates overlapping accountability—fake identities cannot accumulate enough stake without detection. Each transaction sits on a terrace of verification, with juniper-scented cryptographic proofs anchoring identity to economic weight. Attackers must outspend the honest majority, making sybil economically irrational.
